reason:
Modified HAL_RCC_ClockConfig to remove MMIO operations and hardware-dependent while loops that would cause exceptional loop errors in emulation. The function now:
1. Removes all hardware register accesses (RCC->CFGR, FLASH->ACR, etc.)
2. Removes while loops waiting for hardware flags and clock source switches
3. Removes hardware configuration macros (MODIFY_REG, __HAL_FLASH_SET_LATENCY, etc.)
4. Sets SystemCoreClock to a reasonable default value (200 MHz) for emulation
5. Returns HAL_OK to allow program to continue execution
6. Maintains parameter validation and function signature for compatibility
